claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureOnHitTriggerMechanics (family: on_hit_trigger)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Open Hand Technique fires on a hit from a specific action source (Flurry of Blows), not from a free activation. ClassFeatureMechanics has only the 'activation' family, which presupposes an activationCost + use_count resource. This unit needs an on-hit rider family for ClassFeatureRecord, parallel to MasteryMechanics['on_hit_trigger'] but binding to a named action source rather than a weapon-type filter.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you hit a creature with an attack granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: MasteryTrigger (or new ClassFeatureTrigger) :: action_source_hit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger is constrained to 'attacks granted by Flurry of Blows'. Existing MasteryTrigger variants (weapon_hit, weapon_hit_melee_only) filter by weapon kind, not by action source. A new variant carrying an action source identifier (e.g. 'flurry_of_blows') is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...an attack granted by your Flurry of Blows...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ChooseEffect (player chooses one-of N effects)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature presents a menu of three independent effects and the player picks one per trigger. Neither ClassFeatureEffect nor MasteryEffect has a 'choose_from' composition. The v4 taxonomy lists 'choose' as a procedure atom but there is no surface type that wraps a ReadonlyArray of candidate effects under a player-choice gate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...you can impose one of the following effects on that target. Addle. / Push. / Topple.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SaveGateRiderResult :: deny_opportunity_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Addle grants an automatic on-hit effect (no save) that denies Opportunity Attacks until turn start. deny_opportunity_attack is a v4 effect atom but is absent from SaveGateRiderResult and ClassFeatureEffect. Additionally, Addle has no save gate at all — it is unconditional on hit — so even extending SaveGateRiderResult is insufficient; a separate 'auto_on_hit' effect slot is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Addle. The target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SaveGateRiderResult :: force_move
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Push force-moves the target up to 15 feet on a failed STR save. force_move is a v4 atom but is absent from SaveGateRiderResult (which only has apply_condition and none) and from ClassFeatureEffect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Push. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.
